form: DD Form 1351-2 (May 2011), Travel Voucher or Subvoucher (PCS travel claim)
pays_or_does: Settles the PCS travel entitlements (mileage, per diem, TLE, DLA and the rest) and closes out any advances; split disbursement pays the GTCC first.
who_files: The Sailor prepares and signs it; the gaining command's CPPA reviews it and submits it.
deadline: Within 5 working days of reporting, and before house-hunting PTDY. One complete claim, no partials.
filed_where: Gaining CPPA via eCRM to TSC Memphis (the Navy's Travel Processing Center)
attachments: PCS orders with every modification
Receipts for lodging at any amount and for any single expense of $75 or more; zero balance, itemized
NPPSC 7000/1 (02-2017) Travel EFT Information if pay goes to a different account
NPPSC 1300/2 PCS Traveler Checklist (a guide, not a key supporting document)
Dependents claimed must be verified in NSIPS
note: Source note: the Travel Processing Center's routing guidance words the deadline “within 5 days of completing PCS travel”.

deadline: Advance requested with the NPPSC 1300/1 (at least 45 days before transfer) and paid about 30 days before detachment; otherwise on the travel claim.
filed_where: CPPA via eCRM to TPC Memphis

For E5 and below asking for advance single DLA, a letter from the gaining command that government quarters won't be assigned
note: A second DLA, paid only when orders are amended, modified, canceled or revoked (JTR par. 050507), uses DTMO's secondary rates, which aren't shown here.

who_files: The Sailor; DPS generates the DD 2278 and DD 3166 at counseling; NAVSUP's HHG Audit Division reviews the Navy package.
deadline: 45 days after you complete the move (PPA). Confirm with your PPPO.
filed_where: Started on or after May 15, 2026: upload to your DPS shipment and submit the PPM for closeout in DPS. Approved before May 15, 2026: email NAVSUP HHG Audit (hhgaudit.ppmclaims@us.navy.mil) for a DoD SAFE upload link.

All orders and modifications

Registration or title for each vehicle or trailer used
Rental contracts (paid in full) and all receipts
Justification for any missing document (for example an accident report for a missing weight ticket)

form: Government Travel Charge Card for PCS (DD Form 3120 Statement of Understanding; Page 13 counseling entry)
pays_or_does: Mandatory card for PCS travel costs (lodging, meals, TLE, POV fuel or charging); not for DLA, PPM costs, storage, airfare or debts.
who_files: The Sailor with the detaching command's APC and Command Financial Specialist.
deadline: Counseling before detaching; mission-critical status at least five days before detachment; balance paid in full when the claim settles.
attachments: Signed Page 13 and DD Form 3120 Statement of Understanding
note: Exempt from mandatory use are accession, separation and retirement orders, IMAs, IRR and anyone not eligible for a GTCC.

sources.quote: A Service member or Service member’s dependent on a PCS order with an effective date of January 1, 2024 or later, as defined in Appendix A, may be authorized reimbursement for the costs related to the relocation of one household pet that arises from a permanent change of station. sources.quote: A Service member or Service member’s dependent may be authorized the reasonable and substantiated cost of mandatory microchipping, boarding fees, hotel service charges, licensing fees at the new PDS, and pet shipping fees if the member flies rather than drives, or the pet is shipped separately from the member.
